title: Keep: registry reads are fd-relative, capped, O_NOFOLLOW
description: git-vouch:128-200 (_open_below, read_capped, list_dir) and 225-258 (read_blobs). Working-tree records are opened one component at a time relative to the parent fd with O_NOFOLLOW and O_NONBLOCK, fstat-checked as regular, and read to at most MAX_FILE_SIZE+1. Historical blobs are size-checked with cat-file --batch-check before any byte is read. The registry is attacker-writable through pull requests, so this closes symlink escapes, check/open swaps, FIFOs that hang the merge gate, and memory blowups from huge blobs. Do not 'simplify' to Path.read_bytes() or git show <rev>:<path>: each loses one of those guarantees, and no test would notice except the specific hostile-tree ones.
close_reason: Kept (Mark 2026-10-23); the four threats are now a comment above _open_below
